'''Air-traffic control school''' was an academy for air-traffic controllers of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rebel Agent" /> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', as well as the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio drama]], to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Nomo]] graduated from the school with the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="Rebel Agent" /> With the help of connections within the Empire, Nomo secured a job on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]].<ref name="Rebel Agent Audio Drama">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>
